gaps.lead: They won't let you in without a ticket.
gaps.explanation: let somebody do → be allowed to do: won't be allowed in.

gaps.lead: A mechanic repaired my father's roof last week.
gaps.explanation: have something done = arrange for somebody to do it: had his roof repaired.

gaps.lead: He would rather not talk about the accident.
No changes will be made to this project.
gaps.hint: go ahead = proceed; according to plan
gaps.explanation: 'No changes' means the project 'will go ahead according to plan'.

gaps.lead: Somebody needs to renew this passport before June.
gaps.explanation: need + -ing = need to be + participle: needs renewing.

gaps.lead: 'I have never lied to the press,' the minister said.
gaps.explanation: deny + -ing (ever strengthens the denial): denied ever lying.
